# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** 18  <sub>[v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c29 P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Treasurer of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy cheeks, dimples, and glossy jet-black hair that she inherited from her mother. She displays a merry expression inherited from her father. Over the years, she matures into a somewhat matronly figure self-conscious of her tendency to gain weight.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c17 P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010), [v2 c17 P4](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0004), [v2 c29 P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Diana is good, smart, and ladylike, acting as a sensible and comforting friend. Though practical and lacking a vivid imagination, she enthusiastically supports the creative ideas of others. She laughs easily and displays an unselfish admiration for her friends' talents.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v2 c6 P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v3 c12 P59](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0059)_

## History

Diana Barry grew up at Orchard Slope with her parents and younger sister Minnie May. As a child, she swore an oath of eternal friendship with Anne Shirley. After unintentionally becoming intoxicated on currant wine at Green Gables, her mother briefly forbade her from playing with Anne, but Mrs. Barry relented after Anne cured Minnie May's croup. Diana attended Avonlea school, joined a Story Club with her schoolmates, and took part in local concerts and outings. Unlike Anne, she did not attend Queen's Academy or Redmond College, remaining in Avonlea where she served as treasurer for the Village Improvement Society. In her late teens, she became engaged to Fred Wright and eventually married him at Orchard Slope. Together they established a home and had two children, little Fred and Small Anne Cordelia.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 c29 P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015), [v3 c12 P10](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0010), [v3 c29 P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v3 c39 P44](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0044), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

- named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her family when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>

## Quotes

> Dear Anne, Mother says I’m not to play with you or talk to you even in school. It isn’t my fault and don’t be cross at me, because I love you as much as ever.  <sub>[v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029)</sub>

> I love you devotedly, Anne, and I always will, you may be sure of that.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>

> Oh, Anne, do come quick. Minnie May is awful sick—she’s got croup.  <sub>[v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)</sub>

> I’d wish to be tall and slender,  <sub>[v2 c13 P33](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0033)</sub>

> Before he came I wanted a girl, so that I could call her ANNE. But now that little Fred is here I wouldn’t exchange him for a million girls. He just couldn’t have been anything but his own precious self.  <sub>[v3 c39 P44](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0044)</sub>
